{{Quote|When they shout and snarl, they're ready to kill. But when they whisper, they're ready to kill everything.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on Trandoshans|<ref name="MA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
The '''Trandoshans''', or '''T'doshok''' in [[Dosh]], were a [[species]] of tall, bipedal, [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] (or Dosha). They had highly sensitive [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that could see into the [[infrared]] range, and the ability to regenerate lost [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] (albeit slowly) in a similar fashion to some lizards voluntarily detaching and regrowing their tails—an anatomical feature which Trandoshans lacked, however, compared to other reptilian species (such as the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]] and the [[Ssi-ruu]]k). They would, however, periodically shed their skin, as do many reptilian species. Trandoshans were physically-sturdier and were considerably stronger than [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and most other humanoids. The Trandoshan species, as a whole, was known for its penchant for violence and domination, with many individuals becoming slavers, bounty hunters, hired guns, interrogators, and other potentially questionable or unsavory professions. During the Imperial Era, the Trandoshans, as a collective, allied early on with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], taking [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], whom they considered bitter rivals, as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

A notable Trandoshan was [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was a longtime enemy of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], as well as the infamous slaver [[Pekt]].

As a species, they were renowned across the galaxy for great strength. This is evidenced by several members of other species boasting physical prowess and power by having defeated a Trandoshan, either in battle or in a contest of strength.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|You lizards need to learn that I'm a lot scarier than you are.|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]|<ref name="RC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ssohregen.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Ssoh]], a slaver whose limbs are regenerating after being [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]]]]
Trandoshans were a large, bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], with scaly skin&mdash;<ref name="NEGAS" /> which ranged in color from sandy brown to glossy green,<ref name="UAA" /> which was shed roughly once every standard year and was very durable. Cold-blooded reptiles, Trandoshans had two super-sensitive varied color eyes with horizontal black pupils, which could see far into the infrared range. Trandoshans could regenerate lost limbs and skin until they reached their middle ages&mdash;<ref name="NEGAS" /> around fifty-four standard years.<ref name="UAA" /> Each of their four limbs ended in three razor sharp claws. These were perfect for combat, but did not grant them manual dexterity, making a Trandoshan's finger movements somewhat clumsy and awkward.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Though physically powerful, they were outmatched by their rivals, the Wookiees, in unarmed combat.

Trandoshans usually wore dark clothing,<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies]] promotional image''</ref> although the species' attire varied. The infamous Trandoshan [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was known to wear a yellow flight suit,<ref name="ESB" /> something worn by several other members of the species. Trandoshan hunters and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] sometimes wore either full [[Armor/Legends|body armor]] or a mixture of armor and cloth garb.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Trandoshans also often wore warm jackets and baggy trousers.<ref name="UAA" /> They also walked barefooted, as their large, scaled feet meant that it was impossible for them to wear any sort of baseline humanoid footwear, which could present impediment to hunting.<ref name="NEGAS" />

Trandoshans had a lifespan slightly shorter than that of most sentients in the galaxy. Considered younglings until they were eleven [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] old, Trandoshans were thought of as young adults until they reached the age of fifteen, when they became full adults. By thirty five standard years, Trandoshans were middle-aged, and those living past fifty were considered old. Any Trandoshan living over sixty years was thought to be venerable, and were greatly respected by society.<ref name="UAA" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Lizard people. Cold-blooded in every sense of the word. They worship a goddess they believe wants them to treat everyone else like prey.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:MS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|My Sponsorship|Hutta}}</ref>}}
[[File:Trandoshan-warrior-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|230px|A Trandoshan warrior during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]]]
Trandoshans worshiped their goddess, the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] (a deity who exists beyond [[Time/Legends|time]] and [[Realspace/Legends|space]]), whom they would appease through acts which increased their [[Jagannath point/Legends|''jagannath points'']]. This was done by living a lifestyle which was, by non-Trandoshan standards, overtly aggressive, leading many Trandoshans to become [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], mercenaries, or [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. Trandoshans especially prized Wookiee pelts, which consequently played a large part in earning jagannath points&mdash;capturing the pelts of rare Wookiee breeds (such as silverbacks) or particularly infamous Wookiees would give the hunter a large increase in jagganath points. To be shamed or captured during a hunt would zero one's jagganath points&mdash;effectively making their life forfeit in the eyes of the Scorekeeper. They could, however, win all those points back by killing the one who zeroed their score.<ref name="MA" />

The lack of dexterity in their hands led the Trandoshans to develop the [[X10-D draft droid]] to perform manual labor. These could only be owned by those Trandoshans with a certain number of jagannath points.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Like their neighbors, the Wookiees, the Trandoshans also honored [[Life debt/Legends|life debts]]. The recipient of a Trandoshan's first life debt was referred to as a [[ghrakhowsk]]. Trandoshans were known to eat bowls of still live worms as a favorite meal. A traditional Trandoshan food was [[Trandoshani flatcake]]. They were known to have a [[lizard dance]], of which [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] was familiar.<ref name="MA" />

There were rare cases of Trandoshans not adhering to their millennia-old cultural traditions. One such was the mercenary and assassin [[Nakaron]] whose self-confidence caused him to disregard the Trandoshan class system, being rude and disrespectful towards the Elders of the Dosha city of [[Forak]], this led to him being banned from that city, and subsequently more cities until he was virtually exiled from Dosha.

While Trandoshans generally had a reputation for being thuggish, cruel, and bloodthirsty, and this was certainly true of a great many of them, not all were quite so malevolent. [[Qyzen Fess]] was a companion of [[The Barsen'thor]] and proved himself a dependable ally to his Jedi friend<ref name="MA2">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>, and other members of the species were capable of empathy and compassion depending on the situation. Some were even able to work with Wookiees despite the general animosity between the two species.<ref name="SWRPG">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Finally, a few Trandoshans, such as [[Mrssk]], were members of the Jedi Order.

==Weaponry==
[[File:Lethality_Trando_Shadow_Syndicate.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Trandoshan armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]]]
The Trandoshan arsenal was composed of a variety of unique weaponry. For ranged weaponry, the Trandoshans designed Accelerated Charged Particle Guns which resembled various [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Examples of these were seen during the Clone Wars; quite common were the [[Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun/Legends|Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun]], the [[Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun]], [[LS-150 Heavy Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun]], and the [[Gatling gauntlet]]. When they wished to take their prey alive, Trandoshan Bounty Hunters favored the [[Slavemaster stun carbine]]. They also made use of the [[LJ-50 concussion rifle/Legends|LJ-50 concussion rifle]] and Trandoshan Repeater Rifle.

Most cultures long ago abandoned the primitive sword in favor of the more lethal [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Trandoshans, however, wielded such archaic weapons as badges of honor. Both the Trandoshan Sword and the Trandoshan Double-Bladed Sword were traditionally forged using the rare ore [[Chalon]] which made them sharper and heavier than Republic blades.

==History==
{{Quote|Smell Wookiee. Trandoshan hate Wookiee. Human ship. Should be no Wookiee there.|[[Corrsk (Diversity Alliance)|Corrsk]]|<ref name="Jedi Bounty">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Bounty]]''</ref>}}
The Trandoshans originated on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], also known as Dosha or Hsskor. It was in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|same star system]] as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the homeworld of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. In [[7000 BBY]], the Trandoshans joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]] Sith troops landed on Trandosha, and the Trandoshans slaughtered many of the troopers. The Sith retaliated by invading their world and burning the homes of the Trandoshans, leading the surviving Trandoshans to save themselves from death by pledging loyalty to the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].

[[File:Trandoshan_logo.svg|thumb|right|[[Trandosha/Legends|Hsskor Dominion]], Trandoshan symbol]]
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Trandoshan bandits [[Trandoshan invasion|invaded]] and occupied the planet of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] before later moving on. At this time, Dosha was only indirectly represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by the Wookiee [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]], much to the Trandoshans' dismay. In response, Trandoshan terrorists attempted to assassinate Yarua in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], a Wookiee vessel was attacked over a moon of Trandosha, resulting in a Wookiee blockade of Trandosha. Peace talks to resolve the issue were conducted [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and failed when it was revealed that the Trandoshans were pushing for Senatorial representation with [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] backing. During the Clone Wars, some groups of Trandoshans involved themselves on the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in several engagements. One such example occurred more than one year after the onset of the Clone Wars when the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'' was taken over by a joint force of Trandoshan slavers and CIS battle droids. Later, the Trandoshans, with the help of CIS forces, invaded the planet of Kashyyyk to subsequently enslave the Wookiee natives. The invasion of Kashyyyk by the CIS led towards an expeditionary team of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] being sent to Kashyyyk by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this act ultimately led to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] itself. Trandoshans also worked as mercenaries and bounty hunters during that time period. [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was a famous bounty hunter from the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and for decades thereafter.

At some point during the Clone Wars, a group of Trandoshans began capturing prisoners, releasing them onto the moon [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], and hunting them. They captured [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]], and [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]]. Ahsoka managed to kill [[Dar/Legends|Dar]], but Kalifa was killed by [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]].<ref name="PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}''</ref> Later, they brought [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to the planet, but the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] proved too strong for them. He managed to contact [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] came with Wookiees to their [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|rescue]].<ref name="WH">''{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

[[Ronko Bist]], the leader of [[Free Trandoshans]], was served as Count Dooku's liaison to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. During the Clone Wars, Bist was maimed by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and arrested by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi. He was then imprisoned within [[The Prism]].<ref name="Ghost Prison 4">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:Befriend_a_Wookiee.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Trandoshans of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] established several slave camps on the surface of Kashyyyk.]]
After the Clone Wars, the Trandoshans suggested to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] that they use the Wookiees as slaves. The Empire, seeing cheap labor (and possible retribution for [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] survival and subsequent attack on [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]) agreed, and hired the Trandoshans to lead slaving raids on Kashyyyk and locate runaway slaves. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated Kashyyyk, yet the Trandoshans continued the raids. In response, the New Republic placed economic sanctions on Trandosha backed by a fleet of warships. Though the Trandoshans ceased the raids, hatred between the two species continued for many years to come.

At the time of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], after [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was blockaded, more commerce flowed through Trandosha. The Trandoshans gained greater military and economic power after this.

==Force-sensitives==
It was uncommon, but not unheard of, that some Trandoshans were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Because of their reputations as bounty hunters they weren't usually accepted as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or even [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; there were exceptions, however, such as the Jedi [[Lissarkh]], a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], the rogue Jedi [[Kras'dohk]], and [[Mrssk]] that fought during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Normally they would use their Force-sensitivity to their advantage as bounty hunters.

==Saurin Subspecies==
At some time in their history, a population of Trandoshans became isolated for unknown reasons, and eventually adapted along a separate lineage and became the subspecies [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]].

They were notably different in their physiology for featuring translucent eyes, and having adapted four-fingered hands, with longer fingers than their genetic cousins.

It is unknown if Saurins carried the Trandoshan ability to regenerate lost limbs, though they did hold the same basic traditions and beliefs, such as bounty hunting and scoring kills to appease the deity The Scorekeeper.

Saurins claimed the planet [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]] as their homeworld.

==Trandoshans in the galaxy==
{{Quote|I was told the Trandoshan were an impossible race to command, yet watch how ''obediently'' they follow a simple instruction. ''Kill them''!|[[Tagta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]|<ref name="Guns of Nar Hekka">{{TCWComicCite|6.13|The Guns of Nar Hekka}}</ref>}}
[[File:TrandoshanExplorer-EotEBtR.png|right|thumb|A Trandoshan [[Scout/Legends|explorer]]]]
One of the most well-known Trandoshans to leave their homeworld was the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. The son of [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] leader [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], Bossk devoured his siblings when he hatched, and in his youth he became one of the most celebrated Wookiee-hunters on Dosha. Bossk then joined his father as a bounty-hunter and became a respected member of the Bounty Hunters Guild. Some time later, Bossk's ship was destroyed by human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his Wookiee sidekick [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]];<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> this encounter made Bossk desperate to claim Chewbacca's pelt.<ref name="BosskTale">{{StoryCite|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters|story=The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk}}</ref>

Many years later, Bossk was one of the bounty hunters chosen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to hunt down and capture Han Solo.<ref name="ESB" /> Bossk begrudgingly teamed up with Wookiee bounty hunter [[Chenlambec]] and his human sidekick, [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]], believing they had inside information on the whereabouts of the two outlaws. However, the two mercenaries led Bossk into a trap, and he was left in an Imperial prison on [[Lomabu III]].<ref name="BosskTale" /> Bossk managed to escape and to steal his ship, the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']], back from the two double-crossers. Several months later, Bossk teamed up with fellow hunters [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] and [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] in an attempt to steal the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased Solo from Fett en route to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], however the attempt failed, and Bossk's ship was left badly damaged.

Bossk fought once again with Fett after the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian's]] apparent death in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Bossk's ship was destroyed, and he returned to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] dejected, so he was surprised when Boba Fett offered him a fortune for some old information. Bossk was responsible for the death of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] father [[Hal Horn]], gunning him down along with the actual target, with whom the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent was speaking. Though Horn succeeded in hunting down and arresting Bossk, [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] to CorSec [[Kirtan Loor]] manipulated the justice system against Horn for personal reasons by finding that since his target was death-marked by a valid Imperial bounty and given poor Trandoshan manual dexterity, Hal Horn and the other victims were unfortunate "collateral damage" since the underlying act was legal. Therefore, Bossk was released. Bossk made several more high-profile captures before retiring from bounty hunting around [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="NEGTC" />

[[Pekt]] was a dark-skinned Trandoshan slaver, known for his sadistic nature and experimental slave capture techniques. As a youth, a Wookiee slave escaped and tore Pekt's arms off; the Wookiee was executed and Pekt's arms soon grew back. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] he helped the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] colonize [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], although they were driven off by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], though Pekt vowed to return. Pekt's reputation as a slaver grew until he eventually worked for an assortment of gangsters, mercenaries and bounty hunters, and even the Empire. After the Imperial invasion of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Pekt was selected to oversee the entire slaving operation. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Pekt was pursued to a fortress by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Han Solo and Chewbacca. Pekt perished when the fortress was destroyed.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

C. [[129 BBY]], the Trandoshan blacksmith [[Khreenk]] arrived to [[Bartyn's Landing]], in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], and set up his business, [[Khreenk's Smithy]]. He was still in charge of it one hundred years later.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Trandoshan_Slaver_PoV_by_barger.jpg|thumb|left|190px|A Trandoshan [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]]]]
There are several types of Trandoshans in ''Star Wars''. The tall, brown-skinned Trandoshans as seen in episodes 5 and 6, which seem to be the baseline Trandoshan; the tall, brown-skinned, misshapen-headed Trandoshans as seen in the [[Dark Forces/Jedi Knight|''Dark Forces'' series]]; the short, middle or big, green, and stubby Trandoshans working as slavers or [[Trandoshan Elites|elites]] in ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''; the massive giant Trandoshan heavy mercenaries also from ''Republic Commando'', and the short, stubby Trandoshans that Gha Nachkt was a member of, who can be seen in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] television series. [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] revealed that [[Saurin/Legends|Saurins]] are a Trandoshan subspecies with human-like hands.
